title: How much does context affect the accuracy of AI health advice?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM health-claim verification accuracy across 21 languages by translating authorized UK/EU health claims and correlating performance disparities with each language's syntactic distance from English.

Measuring systematic variations in LLM claim verification accuracy across different public-health topics (e.g., COVID-19, abortion, general health) and information sources (e.g., mainstream media, government websites, scientific abstracts) using the PUBHEALTH dataset.
